dct_description_sm: see also later Amended 1902 version Lower Similkameen Band Keremeos Forks Reserves 12 and 12A, 1902_2023 (https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/8ARWVM)

Georeferenced map of Lower Similkameen Band reserves Keremeos Forks 12 and 12A clipped from original Plan No. 4 of the Similkameen Indian Reserves, Osoyoos Division, Yale District (https://doi.org/10.58066/2xh3-h716). Located north of Keremeos. Map includes features such as land cover, soil, timber and trails from Keremeus and to Penticton.
